title: Memory unit schema with per-kind bodies

claims.text: The schema requires schema (const lineage.mem.unit/v1), id, kind, level, statement, status, privacy, scope, provenance, receipts, supersedes and body, and forbids unknown properties at the top level.

Each kind restricts level and body shape through if/then clauses: ruling is level 1 with quote_sha256 plus how_to_apply, lesson and negative and episode and open_item accept levels 2 or 3 with kind-specific bodies, and workflow and decision require level 2.
Level 2 units must carry at least one receipt, a superseded unit must carry superseded_by (and a non-superseded unit must not), and episodes must carry provenance.run_id.

triggers: memory unit missing receipts at level 2

decision.rule: Change here when the memory unit shape, per-kind bodies, or level and supersession rules need to change.
decision.failure: A level 2 unit validates with no receipts, a superseded unit escapes its superseded_by requirement, or an episode validates without a run binding.

questions.q: Where does the mem_unit schema pin ruling to level 1 with a quote hash?
Where should I change the body required for lesson units?
Where can I debug why a level 2 unit without receipts is rejected?
